item.text:
Implemented Task 012 and committed it as `48b35e0f7237cebf6b92cd33a767ecbc42323368`.

The server now saves each task’s position per project. New arrivals append after established positions; returning tasks regain their earlier positions. Existing task order seeds the saved positions on startup.

Verified return order across a server restart, `GET /health`, `node --check server.js`, and `git diff --check`. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start`; the server uses `PORT` (default `8080`) and `DB_PATH` as configured.
